verdict: On unbranded persona prompts ('as an SEO agency', 'as an architecture firm', 'as a service exporter') ChatGPT wants a setup checklist: documents, the profession's purpose code, what the invoice must say, GST and LUT, a workflow. Winvesta's 3,845-word architects guide is that checklist and is cited 2.33 times per fetch; Payoneer's India guide is cited 1,501 times. Skydo's 26 persona landing pages are fetched 52 times in total on these prompts: they are the product template with a persona word swapped in, and ChatGPT does not fetch them for 'how to receive payments as a <persona>'.

diagnosis: Persona prompts are answered as a setup checklist: register, open a current account, invoice, receive, keep FIRA; documents; purpose code; GST and LUT; workflow. The winning pages are that checklist with the profession's specifics filled in.
The profession-specific purpose code is the anchor citation. ChatGPT names P1009 for architects and cites the page that explains it. Skydo's persona pages never name a code.
An invoice field list is copied item for item. Winvesta's list became ChatGPT's 'Your invoice should include' list.

Skydo's persona pages are the landing template with a persona word swapped in. They are cited only on branded 'Skydo vs X for freelancers' prompts; on unbranded persona prompts all 26 pages together are fetched 52 times.
Skydo's compliance block (FIRA, purpose code, GST, LUT, SOFTEX, EDF, 44ADA) is the only part in the right shape, and it is buried after two calculators and a carousel.
Retrieval, not citation, is the problem for this bucket: 52 fetches across all 26 Skydo persona pages vs 457 for Xflow's freelancer guide and 1,183 for Payoneer's guide on unbranded prompts.
Long paragraphs did not hurt Winvesta because every paragraph carries a code, a rule, a section number or a fee. Specific beats short.
spec: Write one guide per persona in the focus prompts (SEO/marketing agency, architecture firm, software developer, design agency, IT services exporter, consultant, video production agency) at /blog or a /guides path, separate from the persona landing pages.
H1: 'How to receive international payments in India as a <persona> (2026)'. Author with credential, date, read time.
Open with the persona's real scene in two sentences, then a one-sentence scope line.

Sections in this order: the purpose code for this profession and its neighbour code; what your invoice must contain (a copyable list, including the purpose code line and the LUT line); documents to have; GST treatment with the five export conditions and the LUT path; FEMA realisation window; methods with real fees for this invoice size; a 5-step workflow; FAQ.
Skydo appears once, in the methods section, with its real fee and a real limitation.
1,500-2,500 words, no calculator, one CTA at the end, Article + Person + FAQPage schema.
Link the persona landing page to the guide and the guide to the landing page so the product page inherits the fetches.

playbook.use_when: The query names a profession or business type: 'as an SEO agency', 'as an architecture firm', 'as a freelancer', 'as a service exporter'. ChatGPT answers with a setup checklist, documents, the purpose code, invoice contents, GST/LUT and a workflow.
blueprint: H1 'How to receive international payments in India as a <persona> (2026)'. Author, credential, date, read time.
Two-sentence opening scene from the persona's life, then one sentence of scope.
Purpose code section: the code for this profession, its RBI description, the neighbour code and the rule for choosing, what happens if you get it wrong.
Invoice section: a copyable field list ending with the exact purpose-code line and the LUT line.
Documents to have: PAN, current account in the firm's name, GST registration, LUT, contract, invoice.
GST: the five export-of-services conditions, zero-rating, the LUT filing path, any current-year change with its section number.
FEMA realisation window and what to do if a client pays late.
Methods for this persona's invoice sizes: SWIFT, PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, Skydo, each with a fee and a limitation. Skydo once, honestly.
5-step workflow from invoice to INR, then what to keep for audit.
FAQ of 5-6 persona questions as headings with two-sentence answers.
1,500-2,500 words. Every paragraph carries a code, rule, number or date. One CTA at the end. Article + Person + FAQPage schema.
Keep the persona landing page for product intent and link it to the guide.
